scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
KeekeekeeKeheheh.
This is amazing!
The results are extraordinary!!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
KeekeekeeKeheheh.
太棒了！实验结果简直超乎想象！！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Using my skills in this distant
land was unexpected...
Keheheh... The lord of palace
was quite accomodating.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
没想到能在这遥远的地方施展我的技艺...
Keheheh...宫殿的主人倒是挺通情达理。

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Oops, I better be careful...
If the guild finds out my
location, stupid Myster will
get mad at me. Kehehehkeh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
哎呀，得小心...
要是公会发现我的行踪，那个笨蛋米斯特准会生气。Kehehehkeh...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
What? Wanna say something?
If you are here for tourism,
enjoy your day off, then go back to your hometown.
Keekeekee... Or else,
I will let you taste my acid bottle...!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
怎么？有话要说？
来旅游的话，玩够了就回老家去。
Keekeekee...不然，就让你尝尝我的盐酸瓶...！

scripts.text: Please, excuse me
scripts.translation: 请原谅我

scripts.text: Do you need help?
scripts.translation: 您需要帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh... Did you hear
what I said? It would be
better to forget...
Keekeekeekeekee...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Keheheh...听见我刚才说的话了？最好忘掉...
Keekeekeekeekee...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Help, eh?...
Now that I think about it...
I need some items right now...
Keeheeheekeehee...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
帮忙？...
这么一说，我现在还真需要些材料...
Keeheeheekeehee...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Sir Laspuchin needs some
enchant stones for an experiment.
I will use it efficiently...
Do you have them now?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
拉斯普钦大人需要些属性原石做实验。
我会好好利用的...
你身上有吗？

scripts.text: Nope
scripts.translation: 没有

scripts.text: I got some
scripts.translation: 我有

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Then, find 8 stones of one kind.
If you bring 8 of one kind of
enchant stones, I will change it
to a better one...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
那就找8个同一种类的属性原石来，我能帮你换成更好的...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Then, find 8 stones of one kind.
not the round gemstones but
enchant stones.
If you bring the wrong stones,
I will throw a flame bottle!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
去找8个同一种类的石头。
我要属性原石，不是圆圆的宝石。
带错了，我就扔火烟瓶！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Bring me stones, slave~!!
And keep your promise! Kehehehkehkeh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
把石头带来，奴隶~！！
记住你的承诺！Kehehehkehkeh...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Uh-huh, what did you bring?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嗯哼，你带了什么来？

scripts.text: Mystic Frozen
scripts.translation: 水灵原石

scripts.text: Great Nature
scripts.translation: 土灵原石

scripts.text: Flame Heart
scripts.translation: 火灵原石

scripts.text: Rough Wind
scripts.translation: 风灵原石

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
I will take 8 of them and
give you an enchant stone.
How's that sound?
Keheheh.....
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
我收下8个，给你1个属性原石，怎么样？
Keheheh.....

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
You can't help Laspuchin with just a couple
of enchant stones... I said 8!
Bring me just 8 stones!
Keheheh.....
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
就这几颗属性原石，可帮不了拉斯普钦大人...我说的是8个！
带8个来！
Keheheh.....

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh~ Check your pockets
before you tell me
how foolish you are.....
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Keheheh~先检查口袋，别急着让我知道你有多蠢...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
HeeHee, what do you want? Choose one!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
HeeHee，想要什么？选一个！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Oh, well.
Don't tell anyone about my location...
Keheheh...after all, you did promise~
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
好吧。
别告诉任何人我在哪里...
Keheheh...你可是答应过的~

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Kehhehheh, You know something?
I don't have many of those
so I'm going to take ^0000FF12^000000 of yours, okay?
Of course, it is okay.
It is an honor to help Laspuchin!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Kehhehheh，你知道吗？这东西我存货不多，所以得收你^0000FF12^000000个，没意见吧？
当然没意见，能帮拉斯普钦大人可是你的荣幸！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh, You know something.
I don't have many of these so
I can't just get 8 of yours.
If you want to change them to Rough Wind,
bring me 4 more stones. 8 + 4 = 12...
Requires ^0000FF12^000000 stones.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Keheheh，这东西存货不多，收8个可不行。
想换风灵原石，就再带4个来。
8 + 4 = 12...要^0000FF12^000000个石头。

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh! You've chosen a good one!
Use it well...
Bring me other stones if you have them!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
Keheheh!选得不错！
好好利用它...
还有别的石头，就带来吧！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Bring me stones, slave~!!
And keep your promise! Kehheheheheh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
把石头带来，奴隶~！！
记住你的承诺！Kehheheheheh...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Bring me stones, slave~!!
And keep your promise! Keheheheheh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
把石头带来，奴隶~！！
记住你的承诺！Keheheheheh...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Bring me stones! You said you are going to help me!
Keep your promises! Kehehehkehkeh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
把石头带来！你说过要帮我的！
记住你的承诺！Kehehehkehkeh...
